title: Hopper FP8 activation: adaptive stability selector, adversarial-resilient calibration, and drift mitigation
creator: Asha Kapoor
description: Goal: Enable FP8 (E4M3/E5M2) profiles on Hopper GPUs with an activation pipeline that minimizes accuracy regressions and runtime instability. This ticket covers the selector logic, a hardened calibration workflow that is resilient to adversarial batches, per-layer hysteresis to avoid flapping, and a telemetry-driven drift detector that gates profile promotion to production. Motivation: prior experiments showed occasional outlier token distributions and per-layer overflow when naively switching to FP8 under heavy prompt diversity. Scope: 1) Implement selector with confidence scoring and safety margin per layer; 2) Build adversarial-resilient calibration harness (randomized batching, worst-case synthesis); 3) Add shadow-canary deployment tooling and drift detection for queued KV patterns; 4) Define rollback and mitigation playbook and SLO targets for accuracy/latency.
acceptance_criteria: Selector returns stable E4M3/E5M2 choice with >=99.5% agreement vs baseline across 10 eval prompt suites
Calibration harness finds and corrects worst-case layer scale > 3 sigma within 3 attempts
Shadow canary run for 72h with traffic split 5% shows <0.6% delta in top-1 token distribution for target models (Llama-2 family, Mistral-7B)
Telemetry drift detector triggers automated demotion when cumulative layer overflow count exceeds threshold, with alerting to #infra-quantization
Rollback plan validated in staging with automated revert PR that toggles quant profile flags and warms KV cache
CI: unit+integration tests for selector logic + e2e calibration run in nightly pipeline
